compute.cost_note: two causal LMs (scorer and observer) per manifest entry; GPU recommended for large manifests; --max-entries subsamples; pass --scores-cache on long runs so a crash loses at most the unflushed entries

do_not_use_when: you have no labeled manifest with ai_status positives and negatives
the surprisal tier (transformers + torch, about 1.5 to 2 GB) cannot be installed
you want thresholds to become framework defaults; they remain operator-side

examples.description: Calibrate Binoculars thresholds on a labeled manifest
Checkpoint a long run; rerunning the same command after a crash continues it

inputs.target: a JSONL manifest with ai_status labels

purpose: Operator-side Binoculars threshold calibration. Runs binoculars_audit over a labeled manifest, derives empirical threshold-low and threshold-high values by ROC analysis at a target FPR and TPR, and writes a calibration report. The framework default thresholds stay unset; the output is the operator's own calibration. Logs progress to stderr and, with --scores-cache, checkpoints every scored entry so a killed run continues with --resume.
use_when: you run binoculars_audit and want thresholds calibrated on your own labeled corpus instead of none
re-checking calibration after changing the scorer or observer model
resuming a calibration run that was killed or hung (--scores-cache plus --resume)
